therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: T-cell activation and anti-tumor immune response
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: chemotherapy-naïve patients with stage IV non-small cell lung cancer and asymptomatic brain metastases

results.dose_information: Atezolizumab 1200 mg IV every 21 days, combined with carboplatin 5 AUCs and pemetrexed 500 mg/m2 for induction (4-6 cycles), then maintenance with atezolizumab 1200 mg IV and pemetrexed 500 mg/m2 every 21 days

context.duration: treatment until progression, follow-up up to 48 months
